text: In 2014 the land that was formally home to the Humberside Lawn Bowling Club was transformed into the Ravina Community Garden. A dedicated group of community horticulturalists grow a wide variety of fruits, vegetables, and pollinator plants. Every year they donate a portion of their produce to local charities. The former clubhouse has remained unmaintained since the lawn bowling club left. While the community garden has been able to use a small portion of the building for storage, the state of disrepair needs to be addressed urgently to ensure the structure can be fully used for generations to come.

The Parks and Environment Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to give consideration to the retrofitting of the existing City of Toronto-owned building known as "The Clubhouse" in the Ravina Community Garden in her 2019 budget submission.
